using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int maxn = (int)1e5 + 1;
ll x, y, n;
double best = 1e9;
ll best_num, best_den;

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    while (b) {
        a %= b;
        swap(a, b);
    }
    return a;
}

ll lcm(ll a, ll b) {
    return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
}

int main() {
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    if (y <= n) {
        while (gcd(x, y) > 1) {
            ll g = gcd(x, y);
            x /= g;
            y /= g;
        }
        cout << x << "/" << y;
        return 0;
    }
    for (ll i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        ll L = lcm(i, y);
        ll w = x * (L / y);
        ll step = L / i;
        ll floor_num = w / step;
        ll floor_val = floor_num * step;
        double diff_floor = (double)(w - floor_val) / (double)L;
        if (best > diff_floor) {
            best = diff_floor;
            best_num = floor_num;
            best_den = i;
        }
        ll ceil_num = (w + step - 1) / step;
        ll ceil_val = ceil_num * step;
        double diff_ceil = (double)abs(w - ceil_val) / (double)L;
        if (best > diff_ceil) {
            best = diff_ceil;
            best_num = ceil_num;
            best_den = i;
        }
    }
    ll g = gcd(best_num, best_den);
    best_num /= g;
    best_den /= g;
    cout << best_num << "/" << best_den;
    return 0;
}
